== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[King’s Key]] [[madra]] is a specialized form of energy utilized by [[Reigan Shen]], the Emperor of Lions. This power allows him to function as a master of the [[King’s Key]], which is used for various tactical and logistical purposes. Primarily, it enables the creation of portals that can transport large groups or armies across the world and provides access to spatially sealed treasures. Beyond transportation, the [[madra]] can be used offensively or defensively; it can tear open space, form razor-thin blades, create barriers to obstruct enemies, or be used to grasp and immobilize weapons. Additionally, the [[madra]] can reinforce other objects, such as [[void keys]], and is capable of producing various weapons and emergency defenses.}}
